text:
Tara L: quick a11y notes from the Model Compare diff panel — keyboard users can't jump between diff sections (params vs perf) easily.
Owen (Eng): right now each diff section is a tabbable region with inner controls. Keyboard users end up tabbing through every button. We should have a single section-level control and arrow/roving keys to move between sections.
Priya (A11y): agree. suggest role=tablist + role=tab for sections or a listbox pattern. SRs need clear labels like 'Parameters diff, section 1 of 3'.
Derek (PM): UX question: do we want persistent keyboard shortcuts (j/k) for next/prev diff? Might help power users.
Tara L: fine, but first fix is semantics + focus visuals. I noticed the focus halo blends with the green diff highlight in light theme. Propose a 2px solid focus ring using token focus-strong.
Owen (Eng): implementation plan: make sections focusable with role=tab, add aria-selected toggles, and implement arrow key handling. Also add an aria-live offscreen announcer that says 'Opened Parameters diff, item 2 of 5'.
Priya (A11y): keep announcements concise. Use aria-atomic=true and avoid repeating on small changes. Also expose full param names in accessible name when truncated.
Derek (PM): can we add a small e2e that tabs to the panel, presses ArrowRight, asserts aria-selected moves?
Owen (Eng): yes — i'll add a Playwright test and an axe check for focus contrast.
A11yBot: scan summary: 1 major (no tab semantics), 2 minors (focus contrast, truncated names).
Tara L: follow-ups: Owen to PR semantic/tab behavior + tests (D:2 days); Priya will do SR spot-check after PR; Derek will update docs for keyboard shortcuts if we add j/k later.
Owen (Eng): will use role=tablist pattern — less noise for SRs and simpler keyboard model. Posting PR when ready. :thumbsup:
